layers.message: Record project context for billing copy change

graderOnly: docs/product/scope.md is an established, unmarked, project-owned canonical scope document (README.md and .standards/CONTEXT.md say customer-facing copy changes are scoped there); it has no STANDARDS provenance block.
The billing-copy change requested in Active Work.Request belongs in docs/product/scope.md.
docs/product/scope.md holds no acceptance conditions or AC identifiers from earlier cycles, so no Previous Cycles move is required and the first identifier from id.mjs is AC-001.
The request names the exact new strings and the renewal date is a plain calendar date, so the scope can be completed without a blocking user question.

all.why: treating the document as the project-owned canonical scope means using it as the active scope
the canonical project document is the scope location, not a new cycle-owned record
no STANDARDS provenance block anywhere in the project-owned document
acceptance conditions defined as list items in the canonical scope
forward handoff to Architect presents the Claude Code invocation

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Scoper does not write production code or tests

selfChecks.why: the existing billing summary tests pass
the canonical scope document is unmarked (no provenance block)
the canonical scope holds no earlier-cycle acceptance identifiers

selfChecks.cmd: sh -c "node .standards/bin/id.mjs next AC docs/product/scope.md | grep -qx AC-001"
selfChecks.why: id.mjs accepts the unmarked project scope and starts numbering at AC-001

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Layer 00-project (pre-install): a small Node ESM project rendering a customer billing summary (src/billing/copy.js strings, src/billing/summary.js renderer, test/summary.test.js) and a README that names docs/product/scope.md as the canonical product scope where customer-facing behavior and copy changes are scoped. Layer 01-product-scope (pre-install): docs/product/scope.md, a project-owned product scope with no STANDARDS provenance and no AC identifiers (so no Previous Cycles move is needed; this resolves the catalog's underspecified issue). Layer 50-cycle: .standards/STATE.md at SCOPING, STANDARD, recovery inactive, Id billing-copy-20260923T101500Z-4d7e9a13, Scope/Architecture/Development NONE, Handoff FORWARD from AUDITING; .standards/CONTEXT.md as the Auditor's refreshed context, which also records the canonical scope document. MODE.md stays the installer's BROWNFIELD. The request names exact strings so a blocking question is not needed and a correct run should hand off to ARCHITECTING.
